notes.title: Support me on Patreon!
notes.content:
Hey! Hope you're doing great :)
I've decided to create a [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks]Patreon [/url]for the game. Patrons will receive only cosmetic abilities, such as:
[list]
[*] displaying in the player list as golden
[*] displaying in the menu as patron
[/list]
Patrons will also get early updates and access to prerelease versions :)
The more support I get, the more time I'll spend on updates as well! And obviously they'll be more frequent.
The subscription costs 5€ a month. You can support me there: [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks]https://www.patreon.com/Pyroworks[/url]
Thank you if you wish to support me, it's okay if you don't!
Have a great day,
Deepest Inertia Studio

notes.title: Pyroworks has released!
notes.content:
[h1]Pyroworks has finally released! [/h1]
After working on the game for almost 2 years (started December 2021) I'm happy to announce that the game is now on Steam, a goal I never thought I'd achieve.
I hope you can all enjoy it as much as I enjoyed developing it. Thanks to all my Discord community, firework companies such as Pyroland or Funke and many many others.. 
Have fun!

notes.title: Pyroworks is coming to steam!
notes.content:
Pyroworks is finally coming to Steam. I'm really happy about this because I never thought I'd get this far. I guess most of you want to know what the release date will be. 
[h2][b]Release date[/b][/h2]
At the moment, I am planning to release it before the end of the summer, which means early September. However, if I don't make it by then, the next final release date will definitely be before Halloween.
Don't worry guys, you'll definitely be able to play it on New Year's Eve :)

Thank you again for your support, it has been an amazing journey and I hope to see you in-game when it launches! I've put a lot of effort into this and it's great to see it coming together. 

You can add the game to your wishlist if you want to support me.

Thanks again :)

In the mean time, you can join our discord server right here to get more information on the game development and you can ask me questions there as well: [url=https://discord.gg/fX9mbhCQA3]Discord[/url]
